text:
maria: Hey team — quick one. Sales needs answers for a FinCore security questionnaire (deadline EOD PST). They asked about log redaction, who can see raw logs, encryption-at-rest, and subprocessors. Can we confirm the short, customer-friendly statements we should send? @tim @alex @neha

 tim: Quick answers from my side: we redact PII at ingest where feasible (email, SSNs, credit card patterns) using the streaming redactor, and we don't persist unredacted user content in long-term logging. Access to raw traces requires SRE or Security approval and is timeboxed. Audit logs record who requested access. :white_check_mark:

 alex: Adding a blurb you can paste: `We apply streaming PII redaction at ingestion and enforce deterministic masking in service logs. Sensitive raw traces are accessible only via an approval workflow (Eng-SRE + Security) and all access is logged.`

 neha: For encryption: `All customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256 using cloud KMS. For Redwood Private deployments customers may provide/manage their own keys (BYOK).` Also callout: rotate keys per our KMS policy; rotation dates are documented in the compliance repo.

 infra-admin: For the access flow: our policy is two-approver for external auditor access — request in #eng-oncall with ticket link to the compliance board. We'll issue ephemeral credentials (bastion -> short-lived cloud session). Steps: 1) raise ticket, 2) Security approves, 3) SRE issues session, 4) session logged.

 security-bot: NOTE: Subprocessors list is in the vendor inventory: https://internal/vendormap/subprocessors (shareable snapshot attached to customer responses). Confirm which region the customer wants so we can include region-specific subprocessors.

 sam: Also pinging for doc PR: I'm about to update the public SQ template with the ingress redaction wording — can someone code-review #3456? small wording tweak only.

 maria: Thanks — I'll assemble a concise reply. Draft I'm about to send: 

```
FinCore team,

- Log redaction: Redwood applies streaming PII redaction at ingestion and deterministic masking in service logs. We avoid persisting unredacted customer content in long-term logs.\n- Access controls: Raw trace/log access requires Security + Eng-SRE approval, is time-limited, and all access is auditable.\n- Encryption: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256 via cloud KMS. For Private deployments customers may bring their own keys.\n- Subprocessors: See attached snapshot of our subprocessors (region-specific details available on request).\n
Happy to provide any additional detail or an attestation signed by security.\n```

maria: Can someone confirm I can send that as-is?

 tim: LGTM, send it. :+1:

 neha: Approve from Security side. If FinCore requests key rotation proof we can provide KMS audit logs under NDA.

 alex: Reviewed the PR, left one tiny nit but not blocking.

 infra-admin: Ready to respond with ephemeral access steps if auditors request it.

 maria: Awesome — sending now. I'll attach the subprocessors snapshot and link to the compliance repo. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
